newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss money rates jumpy, SNB adds at 1-1/8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss money rates jumpy, SNB adds at 1-1/8 pct.

text.p: 0850 GMT - Swiss money market rates were jumpy and tended firmer despite the Swiss National Bank's (SNB) injection of overnight and tomorrow/next money at 1-1/8 percent.
Dealers said tomorrow/next had started the day at 1-1/8 percent, but then moved up to around 1-3/8 percent, a reversal of yesterday's pattern.
In addition to injecting short money, the SNB also injected money for mid-July at 1-1/8 percent this morning.
Statements from the SNB's news conference this morning did not have any impact on the market. "There were no surprises," one dealer said. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
